description: This file defines the OutpostsAccessPointArn class representing an AWS S3 Outposts access point ARN (Amazon Resource Name). It includes parsing, validation, and accessor methods specific to the Outposts ARN format used in the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: OutpostsAccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents an S3 Outposts access point Amazon Resource Name (ARN). Provides parsing and validation tailored to the specific ARN format for Outposts, including extracting outpost ID and access point name.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the ARN string into constituent parts and processes outpost-specific data.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Returns the outpost ID extracted from the ARN.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Returns the access point name from the ARN.

methods.name: parseOutpostData
methods.description: Processes the resource ID segment of the ARN to extract outpost-specific components.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ARN data ensuring it conforms to the expected format for an S3 Outposts access point ARN.
